reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, and I actually read labels. A named independent lab with the batch report behind a QR code, plus a known 200 mg of bisglycinate and no oxide, is what I normally have to dig for. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one.
objection: Made in China and a brand with no reviews yet. I would open the lab report first and check the batch number matches before taking a single capsule. At $29.99 it is more than Toplux, so the launch price is what gets me in.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be generic or not for the batch number on the box, I would pass.
